modules.title: 一次发布审查怎样被拆成三个独立检查
主 Agent 怎样委派、隔离和汇总

items.title: 先拆出有边界的任务
items.text: 主 Agent 把安全、测试或文档检查分别交给 Sub-agent，并写清可读写范围、完成标准和返回内容。

items.title: 各自在独立上下文工作
items.text: 每个 Sub-agent 可以专注读取资料和使用工具，详细日志留在自己的线程，只返回与主任务有关的证据和结论。

items.title: 最后由主 Agent 协调结果
items.text: 主 Agent 等待所需结果，处理重复或冲突，再结合原始目标形成统一结论；写同一文件的任务通常需要串行或明确分工。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Sub-agent 不是跨平台统一标准：不同产品对上下文继承、权限、并发、线程和生命周期有不同定义。它也不等于 Skill；Skill 是可加载的任务知识，Sub-agent 是实际执行被委派任务的 Agent。

lessonPractice.title: 上线前要检查无障碍、接口错误处理和测试缺口，三项都只读代码并能独立给出证据。怎样安排更合适？

options.label: 分别交给三个只读 Sub-agent，写清检查范围；主 Agent 等全部结果后去重并汇总
options.feedback: 对。三项互不依赖且不改文件，适合并行；主 Agent 仍负责合并冲突结论和最终判断。

options.label: 让三个 Sub-agent 同时重写同一个配置文件，不划分所有权
options.feedback: 并行写同一文件容易覆盖和冲突。应先明确所有权，或由主 Agent 汇总结论后串行修改。

options.label: 把“检查一切”原样交给多个 Sub-agent，不说明范围、证据或返回格式
options.feedback: 边界不清会造成重复、遗漏和难以汇总；委派时仍要写清任务与产出。

en.title: Before release, accessibility, API error handling, and test gaps must be reviewed. All three checks are read-only and can produce independent evidence. What is the better arrangement?

options.label: Assign one read-only subagent to each scoped check, then have the main agent wait, deduplicate, and summarize
options.feedback: Correct. Independent read-only checks parallelize well, while the main agent still resolves overlapping or conflicting findings.

options.label: Have three subagents rewrite the same configuration file at once without ownership boundaries
options.feedback: Concurrent writes to the same file can conflict or overwrite work. Define ownership or make changes serially after synthesis.

options.label: Give several subagents the same instruction to check everything, without scope, evidence requirements, or a return format
options.feedback: Unbounded delegation creates duplication, gaps, and results that are difficult to combine.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把这次上线前审查拆给三个只读 Sub-agent：一个看无障碍，一个看接口错误处理，一个找测试缺口。每个都要给出文件位置和证据，不要改代码。等三个结果都回来后，合并重复项，按风险列出最终清单；需要修改时先让我确认。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Split this pre-release review across three read-only subagents: one for accessibility, one for API error handling, and one for test gaps. Each must return file locations and evidence without editing code. Wait for all three, merge duplicates, and produce one risk-ranked list. Ask me before making changes.

learning.assumes: You have seen a complex task split into research, implementation, testing, or review.
learning.outcome: You can identify work suited to a sub-agent and specify its scope, deliverable, and synthesis path.

modules.title: Split a release review into three independent checks
How a main agent delegates and combines work

items.title: Split bounded work first
items.text: Assign separate accessibility, test, or documentation checks with clear read/write boundaries and completion criteria.

items.title: Work in separate context
items.text: Each sub-agent can focus on its own evidence and tools, returning only the relevant conclusions.

items.title: The main agent synthesizes
items.text: It waits for required evidence, resolves overlap or conflict, and forms one final result. Shared-file edits need clear ownership or sequencing.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Sub-agent behavior varies by product, including inherited context, permissions, and concurrency. A Skill is reusable task knowledge; a sub-agent is an agent performing delegated work.
